visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark hair, wearing a leopard-print slip dress, is lying on a bed with vibrant yellow sheets and pillows. She looks directly into the camera with a suggestive expression and poses. (2) The scene cuts to a man in a blue t-shirt standing in a room with a white door. He holds a small, red-and-white square foil packet in his mouth, pulling it with his hands to tear it open while smirking confidently. (3) A close-up shot shows the man's hands holding the opened packet, which is revealed to be a 'Nongshim Bowl Noodle Soup Base' seasoning packet. (4) The camera returns to the man's face as his expression shifts from confident to one of intense regret and confusion as he looks down at the noodle seasoning. (5) Hot water is poured from a metal pot into a white styrofoam cup of instant noodles containing the red seasoning powder; steam rises from the cup. (6) The man and the woman are sitting at a dining table; the man holds a large clump of noodles with chopsticks. The woman wears the clear plastic noodle packet as a decorative earring and stares at the man with an annoyed, skeptical look. (7) The woman stands up and walks away in the background. The man, looking defeated yet determined to eat, begins to vigorously and messily slurp the noodles directly from the bowl.

(2) A sharp, percussive plastic 'crinkling' sound effect occurs as the man tears the packet. Immediately, the BGM switches to a grand orchestral score with dramatic violins. (3) A deep, operatic male tenor voice begins singing the lyrics 'I fucked up, I really fucked up' with high emotional intensity and vibrato. (4) A broadband sound of rushing water is layered over the operatic singing to represent the tea or noodle preparation. The music maintains its epic, serious tone despite the comedic context. (5) The singing continues with dramatic flair as the man slurps the noodles, adding wet, rhythmic eating sounds to the mix before the audio track abruptly ends.
